title: Fix the Coffee Machine Before It Becomes Sentient
description: The office coffee machine is making suspicious noises and blinking like it knows things. Investigate, repair, and ensure it doesn’t develop opinions.

title: Rename Variables That Were Clearly Named at 3AM
description: Refactor poorly named variables like $thing, $stuff, and $idk into something meaningful before future-you files a complaint.

title: Convince the Bug It’s Actually a Feature
description: There’s a UI glitch that looks almost intentional. Either fix it or write documentation persuasive enough to pass it off as design.

title: Reduce Console Logs from “Novel” to “Haiku”
description: The console output currently reads like a full-length novel. Trim it down to only what’s necessary without losing critical debugging info.

title: Investigate Why the Server Cries at Night
description: Logs show unusual spikes in activity at 3:00 AM. Determine if it’s a scheduled job, a rogue script, or something… emotional.

title: Optimize Query That Ages Like Milk
description: A database query slows down more every day. Analyze and optimize it before it reaches geological time scales.

title: Remove “Temporary” Code from 2019
description: Hunt down all TODOs and temporary fixes that have been living comfortably in the codebase for years and resolve them properly.
